node.title: AQB c=2 averaged-family certificate payload
node.statement: Provide a concrete certificate for the averaged c=2 quotient-box family at sigma*=8,592,912,738: finite member parametrization, shared quotient/fiber data, reusable box-charge data, and transfer maps to the list witnesses consumed by the AQB averaging argument. This is reduced to a proved coupled family-plus-ledger manifest soundness rule plus the remaining actual coupled manifest.
node.attack_surface: assembly from coupled family-plus-ledger manifest soundness and the remaining actual coupled AQB manifest; no broad local WSL search
node.falsifier: a missing certificate field, a failed quotient/fiber consistency check, or a certificate whose family decomposes into independent single-word boxes
node.notes: AQB ROUTE REFUTED (Pro, verified): convex-combination obstruction — the averaging transfer needs the family AVERAGE (convex comb of single-box counts <= max box), so box-sharing saves log|F| but the ÷|F| normalization cancels it. Gain needs a heavy-fiber theorem (forbidden, circular). See aqb_coupled_family_entropy_manifest_payload/refutation.md.
